title: recharge_pct_per_tick validation branch has zero negative test rows
detail: Every other health-block validation branch has reject rows; the recharge >= 0 branch is unreached by any test — a regression there passes all 153 tests.
recommended_fix: Add health_rows entries: recharge negative (`"recharge_pct_per_tick": -1`) and recharge key missing, asserting the "must be >= 0" rule.

title: E30 exit-band hysteresis unpinned; the band assertion in test_health_hysteresis_band_and_enter is a tautology
detail: ENTER threshold is pinned (ratio > 30), but the exit-band assertion is a tautology — `grace_left > 0 || grace_left == 0` can never fail. Removing the exit margin would pass green.
recommended_fix: Craft a class whose windowed ratio sits inside (27, 30] and assert the latch stays set; assert exit fires only once ratio <= 27.

title: test_health_serialization_pins claims absent-when-disabled but asserts nothing on the disabled dump
detail: Part (a) of the test's stated contract — zero health bytes when disabled — is documented then skipped: dump_off is deleted with no assertion. Only the one-time golden re-bless verification covers it.
recommended_fix: Assert the disabled dump lacks the meter marker (scan for the 0x64 00 00 00 u32 pattern and expect absent), or diff against the same run's pre-feature section.

title: Replay byte-identity pinned only for the lose loop; no replay test for the surge-win path
evidence:
run_init(&live, 7, cat.hash, TEST_LOGIC_HZ)
	live.era = 3
	health_narrow_fixture(&live, cat)
	live.health_enabled = true
	live_hashes, live_evs := health_record_run(&live, 600, cat)
...
	replayed.action_log = clone_log(live.action_log)
	replayed.health_enabled = true
	replay_hashes, replay_evs := health_record_run(&replayed, 600, cat)
detail: Replay byte-identity is pinned only for the drain→lose loop. No test replays a surge-win run, so the serialized surge row and Run_Won terminal frame have no unit replay pin.
recommended_fix: Add a replay pair for the prepared-fixture win loop (surge_win_pct = 90) asserting byte-identical hashes and event streams through the terminal frame.

title: test_health_win_lose_same_tick_lose_wins never exercises the same-tick collision it names
detail: The test documents the real catalog loses at ~510 and pins only the weaker claim (lose precedes the window's close). The actual same-tick collision is structurally guaranteed but never exercised.
recommended_fix: Craft a state where the meter hits 0 exactly on the window-end tick (meter equal to drain, surge ending that tick) and assert Run_Lost, not Run_Won.

title: E24 zero-completion surge-win branch (total == 0) is never executed by any test
evidence:
if state.surge_win_pct != 0 && state.health.surge_done {
		total := state.health.surge_delivered + state.health.surge_dropped
		if total > 0 {

	run_init(&s, 1, cat.hash, TEST_LOGIC_HZ)
	s.era = 0 // no era demand; no seeded spawns
	health_narrow_fixture(&s, cat)
	s.health_enabled = true
	_, evs := health_record_run(&s, 300, cat)
detail: The E24 zero-completion gate (`if total > 0`) in win_lose_eval is never executed: the zero-demand test doesn't set surge_win_pct, so a surge ending with zero completions has no pin.
recommended_fix: Extend the zero-demand test with surge_win_pct = 90 through a surge-era span; assert no Run_Won fires when the surge completes zero packets.

title: Catalog positive control never asserts the parsed health values
evidence:
pt.health_grace_ticks = u32(hg)
		pt.health_drain_pct_per_tick = u32(hd)

	cerr := catalogs_load(cat, &src)
	testing.expectf(t, cerr.file == "", "valid docs must load clean, got %q %q", cerr.file, cerr.rule)
	_, ok := class_index(cat, "email")
	testing.expect(t, ok, "email class must resolve")
	_, ok = class_index(cat, "streaming")
	testing.expect(t, ok, "streaming class must resolve")
	testing.expectf(t, len(cat.demand.eras) == 1 && len(cat.demand.eras[0].entries) == 1,
		"era 1 demand must parse, got %d eras", len(cat.demand.eras))
	testing.expectf(t, len(cat.crises) == 1 && cat.crises[0].id == "surge",
		"the surge archetype must parse, got %d rows", len(cat.crises))
detail: Negative rows assert rejections only; check_ok never asserts the parsed health values. Dropping `pt.health_grace_ticks = u32(hg)` would leave all core tests green — only the health_*.dem goldens would shift.
recommended_fix: In check_ok, assert email/streaming health fields equal 400/1 and 400/2, and balance health window_ticks == 200 after the clean load.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: drain happy path, empty→Run_Lost (E17), surge win, retry, no-soft-lock all pinned by the 17 new health tests (153 tests green). P1 ≈93%: all named pins exist and pin their primary claims; only the E30 exit-band boundary is unpinned (P2). Overall ≈95%.
recommended_fix: Add the recharge reject rows and a real exit-band boundary assertion (ratio inside 27..30 keeps the latch) to pin P1 fully.
